parse_proto_text_to_message: parse a protobuf text format string into a protocol buffer message using text_format.Parse
serialize_message_to_text: serialize a protocol buffer message to a human-readable text format string using text_format.MessageToString
merge_proto_text_into_message: merge a protobuf text format string into an existing message allowing field overwrites using text_format.Merge
print_message_to_stream: print a protocol buffer message in text format to an output stream using text_format.PrintMessage
convert_message_to_bytes: convert a protocol buffer message to encoded text format bytes using text_format.MessageToBytes
